decision: rev-2 (R-1): closes a fail-closed hole at the version/missing-row boundary where maskFields returned RAW for a classified field whose facet-schema-version had no rows (AC-4/AC-12/NF-3 require maximal masking). Root cause: no signal of 'is this resource_type under classification governance?' independent of per-version row-presence, so 'ungoverned (raw legal, legacy all-or-nothing)' was structurally indistinguishable from 'governed but version-missing (must fail-closed)'. FIX (ADR §10, additive-only): the ClassificationSource port is widened to return ClassificationLookup={governed:boolean, rows:ClassificationRow[]} instead of a bare ClassificationRow[]; `governed` is TRUE iff resource_type R has >=1 classification row under ANY version, computed in the SAME single port read as `rows` (no second query, no skew under concurrent writes; T-0053 Postgres DAO derives it via EXISTS in the same RLS-scoped statement). MaskContext gains `governed`. maskFields' `cls===undefined` branch now forks on governed: ungoverned (state U) => raw (legacy floor); governed (state G) with no class for this version/field => unknown class => maximal mask (`drop`, reusing the existing corrupt-class path), NEVER raw. This covers BOTH 'version V has zero rows' (AC-12 version boundary) and 'V has rows for other fields but not f' (AC-4). Fail-closed bias: a source that cannot prove the resource ungoverned MUST return governed:true. Original rev-1 decision STANDS otherwise: value-aware masking folded into the existing single T-0021 projection via NEW pure additive module src/core/data-classification.ts (DataClass enum public|internal|confidential|restricted, closed Transform vocabulary reveal|partial|redact|hash|drop, ClassificationSource port mirrors GrantSource, TypedFacet={fields,schemaVersion} additive widening of T-0015 Facet, selectTransform (class x clearance), pure applyTransform, maskFields, from->to guard evaluateReclassification, ClassificationAuditObligation) + surgical ADDITIVE edits to src/core/grant-resolver.ts (ResolverDeps gains optional classifications?: ClassificationSource; projectFields gains optional 4th MaskContext param; resolveFor's ONE projection step delegates when a source is present) -- still ONE projection, ONE core, no second handle->fields export. data_classification migration 017 (run-seam: 011/012=T-0116, 013-016=T-0017), per-tenant (tenant_id, resource_type, facet_field, facet_schema_version, class), PK (tenant_id, resource_type, facet_field, facet_schema_version), CHECK on the closed class set, ENABLE+FORCE RLS, tenant-isolation policy, choros_app DML grant, appended to known_tenant_tables.txt, NO cross-table FK (resource_type is a kind, facet_field a JSONB key name -- mirrors 008_grant.role_id deferred-FK). Reclassification is a guarded transition/approve op via resolveFor, direction-aware (down==widening==privileged). FROZEN-FILE TENSION: object-handle.ts and grant-lattice.ts stay byte-frozen; coder MUST drop grant-resolver.ts from mutation-gateway-isolation.sh G6-additive FROZEN_EXPORTS, preserving every G1/G2/G6 isolation invariant and the resolveFor/makeGrantResolver/projectFields/visibleFields/grantFacetFields import surface (FE-W23-0008). The rev-2 port-shape change is INTERNAL to the T-0033 surface (the port was introduced by T-0033; no FE-W23-0008 frozen import surface touched; FF-DC17 stays green). FF-DC4/FF-DC12 re-specified to ISOLATE the version mechanism: the fail-closed assertions use NON-null maximal clearance so the masked/absent output is reachable ONLY via governance x version, never via the null-clearance adjacent lever (the rev-1 gap that let a green gate mask the inversion).
